title: Why Your Morning Coffee Suddenly Costs So Much More
hook: Your coffee habit is about to get pricier.
closing: Drink it slow. It earned that price.
question: Have you noticed your coffee getting more expensive?

segments.say: Arabica coffee futures hit $4.41 a pound in February 2025, the highest price ever recorded.
Brazil's drought forced one trade house to slash its coffee forecast by 11 million bags overnight.
Coffee has more than doubled in price in just twelve months, to $4.41 a pound.
